name: Kingdom of Liaodong (Eighteen Kingdoms)
alt: Kingdom of Liaodong under Xiang Yu

predecessors.name: Yan (state)
predecessors.text: southern Liaoning, 'Part of the former Yan kingdom' granted to Han Guang

successors.name: Yan (state)
successors.text: Liaodong, taken when Zang Tu killed Han Guang

ledger.x: 206: Xiang Yu splits Liaodong from Yan and makes Han Guang its king.
206: Zang Tu, King of Yan, kills Han Guang and takes Liaodong.
206: the Kingdom of Liaodong ends in the same year it began.

wars.name: Zang Tu's conquest of Liaodong
wars.outcome: Yan (Zang Tu) victory: Zang Tu 'killed him at Wuzhong, thereby becoming king of a united Yan kingdom' (Zang Tu page); the Timeline page puts 'Zang Tu, the King of Yan, kills Han Guang, the King of Liaodong' under 206 BC.

certainty.note: The kingdom was assigned by Xiang Yu from the old Yan; no survey or treaty lines; the outline is Cliopatria's approximation.
